profile.headline: Sr. Software Developer
profile.summary: Aim high and be awesome! I am a Full Stack Developer, who strives to learn any new tool in order to diversify my abilities. There will always be a solution somewhere! Check out some of my recent work at https://github.com/EricNg314.

positions.title: Sr. Software Developer
positions.description:
• Develop and update components using Aurelia, TypeScript, HTML, CSS, and SCSS to enhance user experience. 
• Collaborated with cross-functional teams to transition page conversions into a new tech stack.  
• Review and address ADA feedback from third parties to ensure compliance with WCAG standards.
• Conducted backend debugging with SQL and C# to help resolve front end issues.
positions.insights: Skills: Git · TypeScript · Aurelia · ADA Compliance · HTML5 · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · SQL · Sassy Cascading Style Sheets · Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) · Front-End Development · JavaScript

positions.title: Lead Front End Developer
positions.description:
• Created Front End marketing content and pages served to over 1,000,000 daily users
• Partnered with more than 4 teams to launch Banana Republic’s 2022 redesign to revitalize brand image
• Provided direction and reviews as part of A11Y(Accessibility) group for cross functional teams 
• Created a/b testing and personalized campaigns for personalized content and metrics
• Lead creation of new feature to increase ease of purchase for customers, increasing web based revenue
• Reviewed React components and documentation to ensure builds are within brand expectations 
• Ensured implementation of marketing requirements from development into production
• Created functional pages using visuals made in collaboration with Design teams

positions.title: Senior Web Content Developer
positions.description:
• Coordinate marketing requirements between production and other development teams.
• Front end development with focus on React/HTML/CSS/JavaScript during development and site production.
• Built reusable templates and applications for development team.
• Troubleshoot issues and bugs.

positions.title: Web Content Developer
positions.description:

positions.title: Teaching Assistant - Data Analytics / Full-Stack Web Developement
positions.description:

•	Support students in their projects and challenges, and provide feedback

positions.title: Accounting Specialist
positions.description:
•	Develop automation tools to analyze and reconcile general ledger for FasTrak transportation project, saving at least $80,000 in labor hours annually
•	Leverage Microsoft programming language VBA for Outlook and Excel to consistently deliver accurate reporting
•	Coordinate with team members, off-site developers, client projects, financial system, and prepare journal entries
•	Review financial reports including invoices from accounts receivable and payable.
•	Assist with month end and fiscal year end close.

positions.title: Data Entry
positions.description:
•	Supervise and confirm Image Review activities.
•	Review system generated image transactions on a timely basis.
•	Secondary validation of processed images.

positions.title: Shift Leader
positions.description:
•	Monitor store finance and quality metrics.
•	Maintain the store’s operational compliance and excellence.
•	Help provide leadership & development of team members.

projects.title: Career Deer
projects.description:
The job hunt is a challenging and scary process. There’s a lot of names to keep track of and even more dates. We provide you with a single location to organize and schedule your progress. There's even job search functionality so you can look at job listings without leaving our site and get reminders when your interviews are coming up.

•	Built with React using a Redux framework
•	Front-End – Create user charts, password reset, and job search form including actions, reducers, and components
•	Back-End – MongoDB queries with aggregation framework, RESTful API routing, responses, emailing, and API calls

projects.title: Rent-All
projects.description:
Project to allow users to rent or borrow personal items. Why let cool pieces of junk lay around taking up space? Might as well rent it out to free up space and earn you money!

•	Manage goal requirements and assist front-end team
•	Front-End – Add and style modals requesting user input, validating user input prior to post requests
•	Back-End – Update server configuration, SQL queries, REST routing, responses and deployment to Heroku

publications.title: Node.Js: Setting up Sequelized for Heroku’s JawsDB, while using environmental variables.
